info.description: T01–T09. Region/template/configuration verification gate required. All IDs are server-generated. Epoch timestamps in UTC seconds. Password reset/change and email verification use Cognito directly; passwords never enter this API. Owner-bound single-use 120-second quotes are required for create/restore and manual renewal. 409 QUOTE_* requires explicit new review; accepted idempotent retries return the original operation even after expiry. Direct uploads and continuous mode default disabled until administrator review. Forecast ledger is not AWS billing. Planning uses exact decimal USD; legacy ledger reservations conservatively use integer milliUSD. Viewer geography does not change CloudFront PriceClass_100 or origin Region. Null prices/partial subtotals remain explicit.

post.description: Owner-bound completion verifies exact size, type and SHA. Missing staged bytes return 409 UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE. S3 HEAD 403 is ambiguous without ListBucket and returns 409 UPLOAD_NOT_VISIBLE; this does not assert that a file exists or that permissions are correct. No operation is accepted in either case: retry the same upload/key or cancel, and contact the administrator if already transferred. Live data is preserved. The worker pins VersionId where available and always ETag plus SHA, including unversioned staging. Accepted replays return the same operation after gate closure.

Checks source checksums, publishes a bounded CloudFront Function update and reconciles public redirect/content checksums. Stable root redirects with no-store to immutable /_cloudhub_site/{release}/ URLs. Local assets must use relative URLs; unpublished and internal paths are forbidden. Old published releases remain accessible; no global simultaneous-POP guarantee. An uncertain publication remains locked for reconciliation.

Query-free response has all T01–T09 and current signup defaults. Detail preview uses the existing regional estimator. Amounts are indicative and cannot authorize creation. Successful responses are cacheable for 60 seconds (Cache-Control: public, max-age=60) and are gzip-compressed when the client sends Accept-Encoding: gzip; error responses use Cache-Control: no-store.
